article.title: Israeli president pardons IDF soldier who executed wounded Palestinian
article.summary: ALBAWABA - Elor Azaria, IDF combat medic who executed a badly wounded Palestinian man that had stabbed a soldier in the occupied West Bank in 2017 was pardoned by the Israeli president from his charges of manslaughter.After being charged for manslaughter in 2017, Elor was released after serving two-thirds of his 18-month sentence which drew severe controversy in Israel. After his release he stated he would “act exactly the same, because that’s how I needed to act”.The execution happened when Elor approached Abdel Fattah al-Sharif as he lay unarmed bleeding out on the ground and put a bullet in his head; this happened after Abdel Fattah stabbed an IDF soldier in Hebron.
